info.name: Car Rental API
info.description: Collection for the car rental API. Import `postman_environment.json` and select the `Car Rental API - Local` environment before running. Run `Bootstrap` first — it registers fresh bronze/silver/gold users, logs them in, seeds rentals to reach each loyalty tier, and stores the ids/tokens required by the role-based scenarios. The `admin_email` and `admin_password` variables must match the superuser created by Docker (defaults from `.env.example`: admin@admin.com / admin).
